Proud to join @POTUS, @DrOzCMS, @SecKennedy, and several others today to launch moms.gov and continue expanding support for women and families through every stage of motherhood.

I’m deeply grateful for this bipartisan initiative. Alabama has one of the highest maternal mortality rates in the nation and more than 1/3 of our counties are classified as maternity care deserts which is why improving maternal health outcomes is a top priority for me. 

I will continue fighting to support families and working to ensure moms have access to the care they need.

This will be a critical resource for families of all stripes to find financial, medical, and nutritional resources. No job is more important than a mom and dad’s. They have enough on their plate raising America’s future, and we should promote policies that recognize that.

Wishing a very Happy Mother’s Day to all the incredible moms across our nation who are selflessly raising the next generation. To my mom, Yaya, thank you for setting such an incredible example as the most wonderful mother and grandmother.

Being a mother is life’s greatest blessing and deepest joy, and I’m so grateful to my children for giving me the gift of being a mom.

Congratulations, @SenTuberville, on joining an elite group of legends as a member of the 58th class inducted into the Alabama Sports Hall of Fame!

Our state’s incredible sports history continues to inspire athletes not just across Alabama but also the nation. As a member of the Board of Directors for the @ASHOF, Wesley was proud to celebrate this well-deserved recognition and the lasting mark you’ve made.

From childcare tax relief—including expanding the Employer-Provided Tax Credit—to no tax on tips and overtime and more, Republicans made sure small businesses were at the center of the Working Families Tax Cuts Act. 

As the daughter of two small business owners, I’m always proud to invest back into the entrepreneurs, family-owned businesses, and local employers who strengthen our communities, create jobs, and drive our economy forward.
